date.source: Its about March 2009 home page reports the match as past; the page's own text carries no date, and the circa month is the directory listing's modified time for the page, 29 March 2009.

evidence.note: The page's headline 'Still Champion' says Blair Kivisto retained the Universal title at Numbered Days against Gage Gannon in a hard-fought match, and its headline 'Why?' says Glenn Legend punted John Hartman at the end of the show and saved Kivisto from the Horsemen. No card or results page for it is in the held record. A show of the same name is announced as next week on the about January 2010 page and is not filed from an announcement.
